quote: I had an amazing experience, and this is coming from someone who has never done anything like this ever before, so it was all very new to me. The yoga, breath work and mindfulness, as well as lifestyle advice was really insightful, and the hot/cold therapy was an exhilarating experience. Highly recommend.
